snippet.title: Street Shuffle Trailer
snippet.description:
MassDigi XP1 trailer for Street Shuffle, a free and super fun card game! Available for download now!
- Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/street-shuffle/id1553484928 
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MassDiGI.Pie&hl=en_US&gl=US
Play as a group of Dunkopolis street performers trying to out-battle anyone standing in their way to stardom! Level up, gain popularity and face your biggest foes!

2021
